hooks.command: [ "$AGNOSTIC_AI_TARGET" = cursor ] && exit 0; sh -c 'd=$(pwd); until [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ] || [ -f "$d/agnostic-ai.yaml" ] || [ -f "$d/agnostic.config.yaml" ] || [ "$d" = "$(dirname "$d")" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; bin="$d/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai"; [ -x "$bin" ] || bin=agnostic-ai; command -v "$bin" >/dev/null || exit 0; AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 "$bin" project --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; "$bin" project -- hook autosync --target claude >/dev/null; exit 0'
